title: Hike up Stone Mountain with Houston

tellings.quote: yeah yeah and we hiked up Stone Mountain when we were in Atlanta even Dr Powell came with

plain: Ky Dickens, a filmmaker who made a documentary series called The Telepathy Tapes about people she says can read minds, recalls a hike from around 2023. She says that while in Atlanta she, Houston, one of the people in her project, and Dr Diane Powell, a doctor who studies these abilities, all hiked up Stone Mountain in Georgia together. She tells it as a warm memory of time spent with the people at the heart of her film.
